Name: Reeves-Reed Arboretum
Description: This is one of the prettiest places in Summit, especially in the spring when the daffodils bloom. It feels peaceful and quiet, and it’s the kind of place I would take a friend to walk and talk. It really shows the charm of the town.

Name: Briant Park
Description: Briant Park is perfect for long walks around the lake. I grew up going here for walks and just to clear my head. It feels very calm and local, not touristy at all.

Name: Boxwood Coffee Roasters
Description: This is the best coffee spot in town. It’s cozy and feels very Summit-coded. I would definitely bring someone here in the morning before showing them around downtown.

Name: The Committed Pig
Description: This place is known for its burgers and crazy milkshakes. It’s a popular hangout spot and always a great meal!

Name: Summit Diner
Description: This is a classic New Jersey diner and it’s super small and old-school inside. It feels like stepping back in time. I’d bring someone here to show them a true Jersey diner experience. It's designed to look like a train car on the outside and inside

Name: Summit High School
Description: This is the center of the community and where so many memories were made. All lacrosse, field hockey, basketball, and soccer games take place here. Going to games here is a huge part of growing up in Summit.

Name: Tatlock Sports Complex (Investors Field)
Description: Tatlock, especially Investors Field, is where Friday night football games happen. The whole town shows up, and it feels like the biggest community event of the year. It’s one of the most Summit memories you can have.

Name: St. Teresa of Avila Church
Description: St. Teresa’s has always been a big part of the Summit community. It’s where people gather for major life events and holidays. The building itself is beautiful and feels very traditional.

Name: Summit Elks Lodge Bar
Description: The Elks Lodge bar is one of those local spots that feels very community-based and lowkey. It’s where people gather for events and celebrations. It shows the more social and tucked-away side of Summit. You must be an Elks member or a guest of one to attend

Name: Summit Train Station
Description: The Summit Train Station is the center of town and where everything connects. It’s a daily part of life for commuters and gives Summit its classic suburban feel. It’s one of the first things people see when they arrive.

Name: Fiorino Ristorante
Description: Fiorino is one of the nicest Italian restaurants in town and feels very classic Summit. It’s the kind of place families go for celebrations and special dinners. It represents the more upscale side of downtown.
